v1.5.0e (2 December 2022) |feed_title = Intermission Lobby |previous_update = [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]] |next_update = [[v1.6.0|Violent Night Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Overview== '''v1.5.0''' is the forty-fifth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 21st of November 2022. This update is notable for adding map voting to the game. This version encompassed six updates, the main v1.5.0 update (released 21 November 2022) and five minor updates, the v1.5.0a update (released 22 November 2022), v1.5.0b (released 24 November 2022), v1.5.0c (released 24 November 2022), v1.5.0d (released 1 December 2022) and v1.5.0e (released 2 December 2022). ==Additions== *[[Default Charm]] *Intermission lobby **Map voting **Map overriding :In '''v1.5.0e''': *New lobby *New Intermission lobby *Ready button *Veto button ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Regular [[Matchmaking]] changed. **It now no longer allows you to just play four maps that change every 24 hours, now it teleports you to an intermission lobby where you can vote for maps. ***Three maps except [[Polluted Wasteland II]], [[Badlands II]], [[Pizza Party]] and some regular maps, will be randomly chosen. Players with the [[Gamepasses|VIP Gamepass]] can pick what maps appear in map voting, overriding already present maps. It is only to pick some of the maps that appear in the game through this. *Fixed [[Crystal Cave]] using an incorrect icon in [[Matchmaking]]. :In '''v1.5.0a''': *Tower, emote and settings interfaces now appear in the intermission lobby. *Changed map override area text from "''Game Voting''" to "''Choose A Map''" *A green arrow now appears when you do not vote for a map for around 10 seconds. :In '''v1.5.0b''' as part of the Black Friday Sale 2022: *[[Executioner]] is now obtainable through a gamepass for {{Robux|800}}. *[[Crook Boss]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|400}} to {{Robux|320}}. *[[Turret]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|800}} to {{Robux|600}}. *[[Cowboy]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|450}} to {{Robux|360}}. *[[Engineer]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|4,000}} to {{Robux|3,200}}. *VIP gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|400}} to {{Robux|300}}. :In '''v1.5.0c''' as part of the Black Friday Sale 2022: *[[Warden]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|800}} to {{Robux|560}}. :In '''v1.5.0d''': *[[Philips x TDS Season]] ended. **Any unclaimed rewards can still be claimed. *Enemies can no longer spawn with facial hair. *[[Executioner]] gamepass taken offsale. *[[Crook Boss]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|300}} to {{Robux|400}}. *[[Turret]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|600}} to {{Robux|800}}. *[[Cowboy]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|360}} to {{Robux|450}}. *[[Engineer]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|3,200}} to {{Robux|4,000}}. *VIP gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|300}} to {{Robux|400}}. *[[Warden]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|560}} to {{Robux|800}}. :In '''v1.5.0e''': *Increased the amount of maps you can vote for in the intermission lobby from three to four. *Wave bonus and error message UI changed. *Fixed the green arrow that appears when you do not vote for a map not disappearing properly after a map is chosen. *Fixed selecting towers in the intermission lobby causing the selected towers to appear on a map after its chosen, which could not be interacted with and did not attack enemies or provide buffs to towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes|
